title: Wire up logPractice mutation in song page
description: Connect the existing logPractice mutation to actual practice events. Track time when audio plays, with inactivity detection (2 min timeout).

acceptanceCriteria.text: logPractice called when audio snippet completes (via onEnded from US-003)
Practice time tracked based on audio duration, not wall clock
Inactivity detection: reset accumulated time after 2 min of no audio plays
Accumulated time logged in batches of 30+ seconds
